content.value: Suppose, a real-estatecompany wants to develop a new town close to Zero Point, (17) Khulna. Identify the major actors involved in the whole process. If governance is a process, explain the negotiation process of the land and housing development. Do you think that such negotiation will bring the best-planned development?If ‘yes’, How? If 'no', why?
